Current capability line

Cortex guidance is not a security control.

Descriptions, synonyms, verified queries, named filters, and module instructions improve generated SQL. Enforce non-negotiable access and retention rules with Snowflake privileges, row access policies, masking or projection policies, and secured source relations.
